doc.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Upsides and downsides of nightclub life
summary: Late hours led to drinking, but clubs let a band work things out.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Is there… I shouldn’t say is there because there’s got to be… both an upside and a downside to the nightclub life?

Well, you can figure that out pretty easily. Yeah, one tends to… in the old days especially, they used to stay open really late. And in order to make it sometimes, you’d… I, anyway, started drinking too much and stuff like that. On the other hand, it’s a great way to… a lotta times, on trips like the one we did out West, we’ll only play an hour in each city. You know, you play a concert and that’s an hour and a half; whereas, in a club, you really get to work things out and go over them a lot. So in a certain sense, it’s great. And even, even Birdland uptown here, that, that was a lot of fun.
